overview: This 142-page file traces Japanese taxation and budget policy from 1930 to 1938, culminating in a diplomatic dispute over special taxes funding military operations in China. Embassy reports, legal memoranda, treaty excerpts, and American, British, and Japanese notes document competing interpretations of the 1911 treaty’s exemption from military exactions.
interest: The documents reveal competing treaty interpretations and why Britain dropped its objection while the United States maintained its protest.
